PART III - LANDS Title Registration REGISTRATION OF TITLE ACT, No. 21 OF 1998 Declaration of Determination of the Commissioner of Title Settlement under Section 14 BY virtue of the powers vested in me under Section 14 of the Registration of Title Act, No.21 of 1998, I, the undersigned, hereby declare my determination as set out in the Schedule appended hereto in regard to the title to parcel of Land Nos. 1 : 93, 1 : 94, 1 : 95, 1 : 96, 1 : 97, 1 : 98, 1 : 99, 1 : 102, 1 : 103, 1 : 104, 1 : 105, 1 : 106, 1 : 108, 1 : 109, 1 : 110, 1 : 111, 1 : 112 and 1 : 113 of Block 1, contained in the Cadastral Map No. 110561, situated in the Village of Mahasengama(Padikaramaduwa,Thelhawadiyawa) within the Grama Niladhari Division of No. 192-Padikaramaduwa in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Galenbindunuwewa, in the District of Anuradhapura, in the Province of North Central, referred to in Notice No. 11/0561 calling for claims to land parcels which was duly published in the Gazette No. 2213/14 of 04th November, 2024 in terms of Section 12 of the Registration of Title Act, No.21 of 1998. P.C. D. Sං඀ൾඋൺ, Commissioner General of Land Title Settlement. Land Title Settlement Department, No. 1200/6, “Mihikatha Medura”, Rajamalwatta Road, Battaramulla. 26th December, 2024
